name: code-writer-agent
body: An implementer agent generated by the agent-builder (the core `implementer` plus each per-subsystem `<name>-implementer`) that turns plan tasks into committed code inside a project worktree. Its tasks include `deletes`, `renames`, and `moves` verbs, whose targets it deletes, moves, or copies on disk — all through a filesystem-operation grant rather than a blanket filesystem capability. Its interest is a filesystem-operation grant scoped to exactly the surface it owns, so it implements those tasks while a path outside its owned surface is refused.
